evidence_plan.requirement: Definition of Random Kitchen Sink approach
Application of Random Kitchen Sink approach
Effectiveness of Random Kitchen Sink approach

payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition, application, and effectiveness of the Random Kitchen Sink approach in offensive language detection.

claims.text: The Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach explicitly maps data vectors to a space where linear separation is possible, providing an approximate kernel function via explicit mapping.
RKS has been applied in offensive language detection, improving evaluation scores when using features from models like Fasttext and Google universal sentence encoder.
The RKS approach achieved a maximum accuracy of 99.53% in offensive language detection, demonstrating its effectiveness in making features linearly separable.
